ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The system generates a report at 23:59 of each calendar day, regardless of whether it is a weekend or holiday.
evidence_from_requirement: Business rule BR-01 defines end of day as 23:59:59 UTC on the calendar day, which supports interpretation 1.
evidence_from_context: Glossary definition of 'report' emphasizes an automated daily summary of processed transactions, implying a focus on calendar days rather than working days.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The business rule and glossary definition provide direct textual support for the calendar-day interpretation, eliminating the working-day reading.
